definition: [ גַּבְנֹן ] noun [masculine] peak, rounded summit ; plural ׃גַּבְנֻנִּים Ps 68:16 הַרבָּֿשָֽׁן׃ ׳ הַראֱֿלֹהִים הַרבָּֿשָׁ֑ן הַרגֿ ; ׳ הָרִים ג v Ps 68:17 (appositive, Thes Dr § 188 and others; others adjective many-peaked ). compare Wetzst Batan. Giebelgeb. 1884 .
